feedback.delta: For WP-09/APP-04 implement deterministic-by-default effect noninterference plus explicit TaskSpawn/ChoiceReceipt/CancelTransition/EffectIntent/EffectOutcome IR/runtime contracts. Do not add surface syntax absent a production counterexample.

H-WP-11/13/14 should perturb actual interleavings, not only replay a fixed event order. Add choice/cancel/effect-intent receipts and compare alternate scheduling against semantic hashes. Existing stale-epoch rejection remains useful but does not prove concurrency determinism.

Frank runtime task/effect/re-entry behavior needs stable semantic task and effect-intent identity distinct from physical thread/attempt identity. Frank itself receives no Harness mutation authority; this is Research Entity feedback.

Workspace/re-entry traces that involve concurrent readiness should carry scheduler/choice receipts so timing/order artifacts are not silently interpreted as GWT mechanism. No GWT mechanism claim changed.

Causal intervention/replay experiments should control or record scheduler choices; otherwise race-order variation can confound lesion/rescue and interaction estimates. No emergence promotion follows from replayability.
Preserve semantic task/choice identity while physical schedules/topologies vary. Schedule nondeterminism is not itself Hyperposition evidence.
No graph truth/activation change. Dynamic run graphs should distinguish semantic task/choice/effect edges from physical worker/schedule trace edges.

Persistence/query schemas should keep semantic task ID, choice receipt, cancellation transition, effect intent, execution attempt and effect outcome as linked but non-conflated identities; dedup decisions must use semantic intent identity where supported.

System-level integration should prefer deterministic-by-default semantic regions plus explicit receipted nondeterminism over universal deterministic scheduling. This reduces hidden scheduler state without forcing one physical scheduling policy.

cross_spawn_feedback.delta: Lowering-preservation tests should include TaskSpawn/ChoiceReceipt/CancelTransition/EffectIntent/EffectOutcome fields once represented in ClayCode IR.
EffectIntent should reference fresh effect-time capability binding/revocation state; cancellation/retry must not reuse stale authority merely because semantic intent identity is stable.
Incremental delta/frontier semantics should not erase or reorder explicit ChoiceReceipts across replay epochs.
